clusters.headline: FIA President Confirms Qatar And Abu Dhabi Grand Prix Will Proceed
aiSummaryBullets: The Federation Internationale de l'Automobile confirmed that the final two Formula 1 races of the season will proceed.
President Mohammed Ben Sulayem stated the events in Qatar and Abu Dhabi remain on schedule.

clusters.headline: Rory McIlroy Secures Record-Equalling Eighth Race To Dubai Title
aiSummaryBullets: Rory McIlroy finished second at the DP World Tour Championship to secure his eighth season-long title.
The achievement ties the record previously held by Colin Montgomerie for the most titles in the competition.
